deferred_source_units.source_text: If the clouds are full of rain, they pour it upon the earth; and if a tree falls to the south or to the north, in the place where the tree falls, there it will be.
deferred_source_units.reason: The actual Job 36:27-29 numbers raindrops, pours rain into a cloud and describes shaded clouds; it does not say full clouds pour rain upon earth. Its unusual old-things wording is preserved. The proposed cloud-rain comparison is not retained as the particular causal image of Ecclesiastes, and the fallen-tree statement has no new supported match.
